items.item_text: Business Systems Analysis, System Design, and System Enhancements: Lead the analysis, design, implementation, optimization, and documentation of complex business systems and application solutions that support the Division of Enrollment Management. Analyze and define divisional business requirements, evaluate existing systems and processes, review vendor solutions against business needs, and recommend improvements to increase efficiency, accuracy, and usability. Serve as a subject matter expert and technical resource for admissions systems, the CRM, reporting tools, data warehouse resources, and related platforms. Lead enhancements for admissions systems and the CRM by identifying improvement opportunities, gathering and translating business requirements, preparing business and functional requirement documents, supporting technical design, coordinating testing, and helping implement new or modified functionality. Develop process flows, technical schematics, logic procedures, and documentation to support system improvements. Apply specialized knowledge and judgment to adapt tools, procedures, and system functionality to meet complex and evolving enrollment management needs.

Project Leadership and Cross-Functional Coordination: Lead and support complex divisional projects involving enrollment management systems, admissions technology, CRM functionality, reporting tools, and business process improvements. Coordinate with functional users, IT, vendors, campus partners, and leadership to plan and implement new modules, system enhancements, workflows, integrations, and operational improvements. Conduct business process analysis and translate findings into actionable system or process solutions. Troubleshoot complex system issues, coordinate resolution with technical partners, and monitor progress through completion. Serve as a liaison to IT, with particular focus on the CRM and other systems supporting admissions and enrollment operations. May serve as project lead for broad or focused assignments under general supervision.

Data Management, Reporting, Dashboards, and Decision Support: Develop, maintain, enhance, and troubleshoot reports, dashboards, queries, data feeds, workflows, and analytical tools that support data-informed decision-making across Enrollment Management. Use systems and tools such as the CRM, Cognos, data warehouse, Informatica, Atomic, and related platforms to create and validate data solutions. Plan, build, test, and monitor data feeds in development and production environments to ensure data accuracy, reliability, and usability. Create CRM workflows, triggers, and automated processes that improve operational efficiency and support enrollment growth. Design reporting tools that help staff and leadership monitor enrollment trends, operational performance, compliance indicators, and progress toward enrollment goals.

Audit, Compliance, and Operational Controls: Lead and support the development of business practices, reports, dashboards, documentation, and monitoring tools that help Enrollment Management comply with federal, state, University of California, and campus requirements. Give priority support to Undergraduate Admissions audit readiness, corrective actions, compliance monitoring, and data integrity efforts. Work with functional offices to identify risks, document procedures, design annual compliance reports, establish tracking mechanisms, and support consistent business practices. Assist with retrieving, organizing, and validating information for audits, compliance reviews, public information requests, or other reporting needs. Recommend improvements to strengthen accountability, accuracy, and operational control across admissions and enrollment processes.

User Testing, Training, Documentation, and Change Management: Lead and support user application testing, upgrade testing, user acceptance testing, and implementation readiness for new or modified systems and functionality. Test upgrades and enhancements to systems such as the CRM, Banner, Cognos, admissions systems, and other technical tools used by Enrollment Management. Develop and maintain system documentation, business process guides, testing scripts, training materials, and user resources. Train and support users across supported departments, helping ensure successful adoption of system changes, new processes, and enhanced functionality. Use feedback from users to identify issues, refine procedures, and recommend additional improvements.
